questions.question: Explain what perimeter is and find the perimeter of a book 30 cm long and 20 cm wide.
questions.expected_answer: Perimeter is the distance all the way around the outside of a shape. The book's sides are 30, 20, 30 and 20 cm, so the perimeter is 100 cm.

questions.question: Find the perimeter of a rectangle 6 m by 4 m and of a square with sides of 5 m. What do you notice?
questions.expected_answer: Rectangle: 6 plus 4 is 10, doubled is 20 m. Square: 4 times 5 is 20 m. They have the same perimeter even though they are different shapes.

questions.question: A garden 6 m by 4 m needs a fence at R25 per metre, but the 1 m gate needs no fencing. Find the cost.
questions.expected_answer: The perimeter is 20 m. Without the gate, 20 minus 1 is 19 m of fencing. 19 times 25 is R475.
